rationale: The nearest enclosing Java type owns an unqualified superclass name in both direct and multi-hop inheritance. An earlier, unrelated nested Base must neither create false overrides nor contaminate the declaringType. localEdgeLabel shortens endpoints to their last two dot-segments (lane convention, see anonymous-and-multihop-overrides / generic-override-signatures), so endpoints and declaringType are spelled Direct.collide / Base rather than the full FQN. Under the old suffix-only resolution, Direct.collide would emit NO override edge (Decoy.Base and Owner.Base collide on the bare suffix -> ambiguous -> no edge); the lexical fix resolves Owner.Base and emits the edge.
